newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial climate cools in March.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial climate cools in March.

text.p: Poland's industrial climate in the manufacturing sector declined for the second straight month in March as demand and output worsened, the Central Statistics Office (GUS) said on Tuesday.
In its monthly survey GUS said the industrial climate index fell to 5 points in March from 8 in February with firms in the private sector better off than public ones.
GUS said the construction sector climate index jumped 22 points in March after jumping 35 points in February as a result of better production and future orders.
The retail sector climate index hits its all time high of 8 points in March, up 12 points from February amid good financial results and optimistic forecasts for future months.
